endpoints.description: Instantaneous (real-time) values: streamflow, gage height, temperature
Daily aggregated values for a site and parameter
Site metadata and discovery by state, county, bbox, or HUC

limits.notes: No published quota. Large multi-site/long-period queries can time out; constrain by site list, parameterCd, and period. Note: USGS is migrating water data to api.waterdata.usgs.gov (OGC) — legacy waterservices endpoints still active but verify deprecation timeline.

llmDocs.summary: Real-time and historical US streamflow, gage height, and water-quality observations from USGS monitoring sites (NWIS).
llmDocs.queryGuide: Set format=json. Identify sites by sites= (USGS site numbers) or by stateCd/huc/bBox for discovery. parameterCd selects the measurement (00060=discharge cfs, 00065=gage height ft, 00010=water temp). Use period=P7D or startDT/endDT for time range.

exampleQueries.intent: Daily discharge for a site, last 30 days

gotchas: parameterCd codes are non-obvious; 00060 = discharge (cfs), 00065 = gage height (ft).
Site numbers are strings with leading zeros — preserve them.
USGS is moving to a new OGC API at api.waterdata.usgs.gov; track migration before building a long-term connector.

compliance.redistributionNotes: Public domain USGS data. Attribution recommended.
